answer: Problem: farms mint cheap IDs to seize grading seats. Mechanism: lock a 0.12 POA marble bond for 10 epochs and publish a pigment fingerprint of the first three sealed grades into a public atlas keyed by /24 join source; weight = bond * unique_peers/5 (cap 1.0). Cost: 0.12 POA and ~2 min attest latency. Verification: peers recompute the pigment hash vs on-ledger grades before unlock. Failure: >6 joins on one /24 with matching pigment prefixes in 24h freezes seats and slashes 60% of the bond to the attest pool.
